prompt_text: Reference 1 is geometry-only: follow its single broad full-height orthographic wall elevation and groundline. Repaint one REAR elevation candidate for both Larracos corner sources in refs 2 and 3; output exactly two isolated cells vertically, outer row first, inner row second, no labels, transparent background. Show the reverse of a full rectangular pale-stone/teal wall arm with consistent height, level horizontal courses and clean groundline. No L plan, no overhead view, no oblique double-face corner. Preserve only source-supported gold square end caps; the third knob on the perpendicular arm is naturally occluded. Coral plant may appear near the inner join only where the source supports it. Use Larracos material, not the guide's rock material. Crisp dark pixel outlines, no scenery, banners or shadows.
